instruction: Classify the support ticket and draft a short reply.
input: I was charged twice for order #4812.
output: Intent: billing_dispute. Priority: high. Reply: I'm sorry about the duplicate charge on order #4812. I've flagged it for a refund; you'll see it within 5 business days.

instruction: Classify the support ticket and draft a short reply.
input: How do I change my delivery address?
output: Intent: account_update. Priority: medium. Reply: You can change your delivery address under Account → Addresses before the order ships.

instruction: Classify the support ticket and draft a short reply.
input: The app crashes every time I log in.
output: Intent: technical_issue. Priority: high. Reply: Sorry about that. Please update to the latest version; if it still crashes, send us your device model and we'll investigate.

instruction: Classify the support ticket and draft a short reply.
input: Do you ship to Canada?
output: Intent: pre_sales. Priority: low. Reply: Yes, we ship to Canada. Delivery usually takes 5–8 business days.

instruction: Classify the support ticket and draft a short reply.
input: Please delete my account and all my data.
output: Intent: privacy_request. Priority: high. Reply: We've received your deletion request and will complete it within 30 days as required by law. You'll get a confirmation email.

instruction: Classify the support ticket and draft a short reply.
input: My package says delivered but I never got it.
output: Intent: delivery_issue. Priority: high. Reply: I'm sorry your package is missing. I've opened a trace with the carrier and will update you within 48 hours.

instruction: Classify the support ticket and draft a short reply.
input: Can I return shoes I wore once?
output: Intent: returns. Priority: medium. Reply: Items can be returned within 30 days if they show no signs of wear. Lightly tried-on shoes in original packaging qualify.

instruction: Classify the support ticket and draft a short reply.
input: Your discount code SAVE20 doesn't work.
output: Intent: promotion_issue. Priority: medium. Reply: SAVE20 applies to full-price items over $50. If your cart qualifies and it still fails, reply with a screenshot.

instruction: Classify the support ticket and draft a short reply.
input: I want to cancel my subscription.
output: Intent: cancellation. Priority: medium. Reply: You can cancel anytime under Account → Subscription. Your access continues until the end of the billing period.

instruction: Classify the support ticket and draft a short reply.
input: Is the blue jacket available in XL?
output: Intent: pre_sales. Priority: low. Reply: The blue jacket is back in stock in XL next week. Tap 'Notify me' on the product page to get an alert.

instruction: Classify the support ticket and draft a short reply.
input: I forgot my password and the reset email never arrives.
output: Intent: account_access. Priority: high. Reply: Please check your spam folder. If it's not there, I can send the reset link to a verified backup email.

instruction: Classify the support ticket and draft a short reply.
input: Why was my card declined?
output: Intent: payment_issue. Priority: high. Reply: Declines usually come from the bank. Please confirm the billing address matches your card, or try another payment method.

instruction: Classify the support ticket and draft a short reply.
input: Can I change the size on an order I placed an hour ago?
output: Intent: order_change. Priority: medium. Reply: Yes — orders can be edited for 2 hours after purchase under Orders → Edit.

instruction: Classify the support ticket and draft a short reply.
input: Your courier was rude to me.
output: Intent: complaint. Priority: medium. Reply: I'm sorry for that experience. I've shared your feedback with our delivery partner.

instruction: Classify the support ticket and draft a short reply.
input: Do you offer gift wrapping?
output: Intent: pre_sales. Priority: low. Reply: Yes, gift wrapping is available at checkout for $4.

instruction: Classify the support ticket and draft a short reply.
input: I received the wrong item.
output: Intent: fulfillment_error. Priority: high. Reply: Sorry about the mix-up. I've sent a prepaid return label and shipped the correct item today.

instruction: Classify the support ticket and draft a short reply.
input: How long does a refund take?
output: Intent: billing_question. Priority: low. Reply: Refunds are processed within 2 business days and appear on your statement in 3–5 business days.

instruction: Classify the support ticket and draft a short reply.
input: Can I speak to a human?
output: Intent: escalation. Priority: medium. Reply: Of course — I'm connecting you with a support specialist now.

instruction: Classify the support ticket and draft a short reply.
input: The website shows prices in the wrong currency.
output: Intent: technical_issue. Priority: low. Reply: You can switch currency in the footer of any page. Let us know if it doesn't stick.

instruction: Classify the support ticket and draft a short reply.
input: My order hasn't shipped after 10 days.
output: Intent: delivery_issue. Priority: high. Reply: I apologize for the delay. I've escalated your order to the warehouse and will confirm a ship date within 24 hours.
